[The archive grows by one room per year]{.eyebrow}

Each year of the workshop, and the ecological dynamics seminars that preceded it, gets an archive page here: a short recap, photos, and the materials that came out of it. We are assembling the archive now; past years will appear as they are compiled.

If you attended a past seminar and have photos or materials worth keeping, send them to [sd33@txstate.edu](mailto:sd33@txstate.edu).
